summary.text: Kim Holloway is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 2 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was born in Paducah and earned degrees from Murray State University and Lindenwood University.

paragraphs.text: Kimberly Holloway was born in Paducah, Kentucky.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Murray State University in 2000, a graduate degree from Murray State in 2011, and a graduate degree from Lindenwood University in 2014.
She took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2025, as the successor to Richard Heath.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Agriculture Committee, the Committee on Families and Children, and the Health and Family Services Committee.
She advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
